CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization/emergence/access was asserted.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization/presentation instance (position set) and a separate origin/status field are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change claim tied to identified content's presentation/access is present.

C.rationale: Multiple literal entries identify specific content items (color-labeled sets) and their locations.

D.rationale: The report separately lists content (color/positions) and a distinct origin/status field for the same referent.

O.rationale: The text specifies how content is presented (grid orientation and explicit position sets; current vs candidate organization).
